# apipbx_firewall_provider (Resource)

A carrier template of your own: a provider's gateways and address blocks, kept once and used by carriers (apipbx_firewall_carrier, provider_id = this id) like the built-in ones such as magrathea. Changing it changes every carrier that uses it. The built-in templates cannot be managed here. A template that a carrier still uses cannot be destroyed. Import with the id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) a-z 0-9 -, starts with a letter, at most 32; not custom or a built-in id.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `hosts` (Attributes List) The provider's gateways; their addresses are looked up every minute. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosts))
- `notes` (List of String) Where the data comes from.
- `prefixes` (Set of String) Every address block the provider announces (IPv4 and IPv6). At least one host or block is needed.
- `verified` (String) When it was last checked: addresses go stale.

<a id="nestedatt--hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosts`

Required:

- `host` (String)

Optional:

- `use` (String) What the gateway is for (SIP, IAX2...).
